visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in an indoor museum hall, where dark-colored walls provide high contrast for white display cabinets. Various mineral specimens are meticulously arranged on shelves and under bright spotlights. Characters are absent; instead, the focus is on these static geological objects. Yellow and white text banners are visible at the top and bottom of the frame, providing context. (2) Successive shots offer close-up views of diverse minerals, including green malachite with its unique circular patterns and reddish-brown iron-rich ores. A detailed moon rock specimen is showcased within a specialized glass container. The lighting is crisp and artificial, highlighting the textures of each rock. The camera smoothly pans across the displays, transitioning between different mineral families. (3) The final segment features a large amethyst geode, split open to reveal its crystalline purple interior, and a jagged piece of native gold. The background remains the dark, controlled environment of the museum. Final text overlays appear, including a variety-show style punchline in colorful Chinese characters, while the overall setting remains sterile and focused on the exhibits.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A dark museum hall with white display shelves and glass cases containing various colorful mineral and rock specimens. Spotlights highlight individual items.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A deep, resonant male voice begins narrating in Traditional Chinese, characterized by a professional and calm tone typical of a museum guide. The speech rate is moderate with clear articulation. Accompanying this is a soft, ambient synthesizer track that provides a warm, steady harmonic foundation. No incidental noises or sound effects interrupt this initial introductory phase. (2) As the narrator describes the different halls and themes, his vocal pitch remains low but exhibits more dynamic intonation to maintain engagement. The electronic music continues at a steady 80 BPM, featuring gentle rhythmic pulsations that stay well below the vocal level. The acoustic environment is pristinely clean, indicating a high-quality studio voice-over recording without any room reverb. (3) In the final phase, the narrator delivers a humorous pun, and his voice carries a slightly more playful inflection. The BGM swells momentarily, providing a brief musical accentuation to the joke. The audio ends with a clean fade-out of both the vocal and music tracks. No percussive sound effects or environmental noises were detected throughout the entire duration.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To introduce a new mineral exhibition at the National Museum of Natural Science in Taiwan. It uses high-quality footage of the specimens combined with professional narration and a final comedic pun to engage viewers and encourage visitation.
